authority: main_implementation plan.md P08.1; api design.md section 3.1
scope: Only durable P05 research_run queue jobs are currently projected. The detail route accepts the canonical queue job ID and the run ID alias emitted by P05 cancel/retry; the list emits canonical queue job IDs.
authorization: Both routes require an organization_id query parameter resolved through membership. Detail requires token and role operation:read plus project:read access; list requires token and owner/admin role ops:read. Reads remain inside tenant RLS.
pagination: List uses a bounded UUID cursor and stable job ID ordering; state and kind filters are constrained to known values.
limitation: Plan, snapshot and source-probe operations are not yet included. Retryable failure detail is not emitted because the current Operation contract has no failure field and the queue does not store a safe structured error. No production acceptance is claimed.
